handoff_text:
HDS MARKETING - PRODUCTION HANDOFF
Customer: Pepsi Co  [Antera: HSR-4126813]
Artwork file: Pepsi_2023.svg
Decoration method: screen_print
Thread/ink: Wilflex Epic Plastisol (red and navy)

LINE ITEMS:
  - 160 x T-shirt (100% cotton) (Royal Blue) @ Center Chest 20.0x8.0" [XS=20, S=20, M=20, L=20, XL=20, 2XL=20, 3XL=20, 4XL=20] @ $33.72/pc = $5,395.68
  - 50 x Denim jacket (Black Denim) @ Full Back 10.0x12.0" [L=50] @ $61.65/pc = $3,082.71

TOTAL UNITS: 210
HOUSE COST: $6,280.30
CUSTOMER QUOTE: $8,478.39
GROSS MARGIN: $2,198.09 (35% markup)

PRODUCTION NOTES:
  - Verify customer trademark clearance for Pepsi logo production
  - Import SVG into screen-print RIP software (e.g., Corel, Adobe), create separate CMYK color separations for red and navy, and generate film positives at 1:1 scale
  - Prepare two screens (156 mesh) with emulsion, expose, and test print on white 100% cotton t-shirt to confirm color match and ink cure
  - Set up multi-color press with platen and cure unit; run sample 5-piece batch, QC for registration, color saturation, and hand feel; proceed to full order

approval_log.notes: Order seeded directly at stage 'pending_production_mgr' for demo.
